card.text: Outer moon of Uranus on a backward orbit, found in 1999.

introduction.text: Holman, Kavelaars, Gladman, Petit and Scholl found Prospero in 1999. Its brightness changes suggest an elongated body, but its spin period is uncertain.

model.summary: An elongated ellipsoid built on one of several possible spin periods; its depth and orientation are assumed.
